answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent sends one crystal-clear signal of attested history, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake. No harbor of unearned reputation can shelter copies, because a record that cannot be cloned is checked before any vote counts, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup.
